member.name: T:ExxerCube.Prisma.Infrastructure.BrowserAutomation.Siara.AutomatedLoginSiaraSessionProvider
member.summary: provider: drives SIARA's login form unattended with credentials sourced transiently from a client secret store (), used once and discarded, producing a credential-free . Enables 24/7 operation (ADR-010).

remarks.para: ⚠️ Liability-gated. This is the mode whose lawfulness is gated on legal sign-off (ADR-010 P1/P2/P4). Engineering preconditions honored here: the credentials are read transiently and disposed immediately after the login (P5 — they are never persisted and the self-clears), and every attempt is gated by the (P3 — exponential backoff + hard stop-and-alert) so an unattended loop can never become a retry storm that locks out the bank's real SIARA account.

Only a genuine login rejection (the form was submitted and SIARA refused) counts toward the lockout threshold; infrastructure faults (browser launch, navigation, capture) fail closed without tripping the breaker, because they never reach SIARA's auth.

member.name: T:ExxerCube.Prisma.Infrastructure.BrowserAutomation.Siara.InteractiveLoginSiaraSessionProvider
member.summary: provider: a human logs in once on SIARA's own page in a headed browser, and Prisma captures the resulting authenticated context as a credential-free the headless watch loop can keep warm (ADR-010).

remarks.para: Acquisition launches the (headed) browser, navigates to the configured SIARA login page, then waits up to (falling back to the configured default) for the post-login selector to appear — i.e. for the human to finish whatever auth SIARA presents (password, MFA, CAPTCHA). It never types credentials itself: the human does. Once the selector appears, it captures a portable storage-state so the watch loop (MVP-PATH 1.2) can re-hydrate headlessly.

The headed launch option is an adapter/DI concern (S7); this provider only drives navigation, the post-login wait, and the storage-state capture. The captured is a bearer session secret (ADR-010 footnote 1) — never log it in full. This provider carries no username/password.

member.summary: The real SIARA document downloader (MVP-PATH 1.1): adapts the existing browser-automation scraper ( + ) into the port the Orion worker consumes, behind the credential-free SIARA auth seam (ADR-010).

remarks.para: Railway-Oriented and fail-closed: it resolves the configured (), acquires a credential-free , hydrates this scope's browser with the session's storage-state, navigates to SIARA, finds the requested document among the links SIARA presents, and downloads it. Any failed step yields a failure result — never an empty-but-successful download. The returned carries the trustworthy and session id that authorized the pull, realizing per-document non-repudiation (ADR-010 P2).

The session is always released in a finally so an acquired session never leaks, even on a mid-pull failure. Browser teardown is left to the DI scope (the Playwright adapter is disposed at scope end); the launch/attach lifecycle versus the provider's own attach is exercised end-to-end against the cookie-faithful simulator (the 1.1 integration test).

Any failed step yields a failure result — never a silently-empty success.

This instance is scoped and is meant to live for the lifetime of the watch loop's single long-lived discovery scope, so the browser and session stay warm. It releases the session on disposal (scope teardown). The browser is launched at most once for the passthrough mode (whose acquisition attaches to an existing browser); the login modes launch their own browser inside acquisition, so this source does not pre-launch for them.
